head: GPT-Knowledge main
summary: Compatibility audit is complete. DeepSeek Harness is a usable external reference, but Brew adoption is blocked until required adapters and governance equivalence are proven in a governed local execution.

items.title: Official capability reference
items.detail: Harness officially documents plugin-based models, tools, sessions, sandboxes, storage, loops and UI; it remains a developer preview with evolving APIs.

items.title: Brew compatibility mapping
items.detail: Provider routing, tools, sessions, receipts and UI projection require adapters. Raw tool dispatch is not equivalent to Brew policy and chained receipts.

items.title: Missing or unverified governance equivalence
items.detail: No verified equivalent was established for Brew approval enforcement. Workspace identity and confinement must remain Brew-owned.

items.title: Governed executable proof
items.detail: Harness package/executable was absent locally and no governed Brew-style Harness task ran. Runtime adoption remains unproven.

items.title: Regression evidence retained
items.detail: Existing Brew resource-policy tests passed 13, autonomy tests passed 10, and memory/session tests passed 18. These protect Brew boundaries but do not prove Harness integration.
